// diagnostic L2421

Jet.InferredNeverReturn

Public function `{function}` always diverges but does not declare `Never`.

What

Public function `{function}` always diverges but does not declare `Never`.

Why

Inferred divergence is useful to callers but is not part of the written API contract.

Fix

Write `-> Never` as the return type, for example `{function}: fn() -> Never`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning Jet.InferredNeverReturn: Tests/UILint/inferred_never_return.warn.

  --> Tests/UILint/inferred_never_return.jet:4:1
    |
  4 | fail: fn(message: String) { panic(message) }
    | ^^^^
 Why: Inferred divergence is useful to callers but is not part of the written API contract
 Fix: Write `-> Never` as the return type, for example `fail: fn() -> Never`
